extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians/authors submitting research in geometry and topology to the journal Geometry & Topology
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and policies for authors who wish to submit research manuscripts to the journal Geometry & Topology, including scope, peer-review style, submission format, access and preservation policies, and related editorial policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aims and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Geometry & Topology is a fully refereed journal covering all of geometry and topology, broadly understood.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts should fall within the broad field of geometry and topology as understood by the journal; see the linked 'Aims and scope' page for more detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fully refereed quality standard
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal is fully refereed, i.e. all published articles undergo peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publication implies successful refereeing; authors should expect standard refereeing procedures and standards appropriate for a fully refereed mathematics journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer-review model (single-anonymized)
rubrics_metrics.description: This journal operates a single-anonymized review process (the names of the reviewers are hidden from the author).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Further information, including expectations and responsibilities for the journal and for reviewers, is available on the peer-review process page linked from the journal site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer and editorial expectations/responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal sets out expectations and responsibilities for the journal and for reviewers in its peer-review documentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors and reviewers should consult the peer-review process documentation for details of timeframes, confidentiality, conflict-of-interest handling, and other procedural norms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission format requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors may submit manuscripts in PDF format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts should be prepared and submitted as PDFs via the submission form; authors are directed to follow the submission guidelines page for any additional format specifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow submission guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors should follow the journal's submission guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The submission guidelines page (linked) contains detailed instructions about preparing manuscripts, any style preferences, and procedural details for submission; authors are expected to comply with those rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission mechanism
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts are submitted via the journal's submission form (link provided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided submission form/portal for uploads and metadata; follow any portal-specific instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No author fees
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal does not charge any author fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors can expect no article processing charges for publication in Geometry & Topology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access policy / embargoed open access
rubrics_metrics.description: All articles become free to access and read six years past publication (meaning on the sixth January 1st after the publication date).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Until that time articles are available by subscription unless a specific year's content is opened by the Subscribe to Open program; see 'Journal access and fees' for subscription details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscribe to Open policy
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal uses a Subscribe to Open model: each year, if enough subscribers continue to support the journal, that year's articles will be published open access — free to read by everyone and with no author charges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors and readers can consult the linked explanatory material; note the update that 2023—2026 articles are published open access thanks to subscribers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preservation of access
rubrics_metrics.description: MSP is a member of CLOCKSS and of the Global LOCKSS Network to ensure long-term availability of published online content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This membership is intended to provide guaranteed long-term preservation and access to the journal's content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethics and editorial policies
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about the journal's editorial principles, its policies for authors, the handling of complaints and appeals, and copyright and licensing can be found on the 'Ethics and policies' page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should consult the ethics and policies documentation for rules on authorship, plagiarism, conflicts of interest, appeals, copyright transfer/licensing options, and complaint procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indexing and discoverability
rubrics_metrics.description: Geometry & Topology is indexed in MathSciNet, zbMATH Open, Scopus, Scimago Journal Rank, Web of Science, and Journal Citation Report / Impact Factor (Clarivate).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indexing in these services indicates discoverability and standard bibliographic tracking; authors may cite these listings as indicators of journal visibility and impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication schedule and size
rubrics_metrics.description: Geometry & Topology publishes 9 issues per year, for an expected total of about 3500 pages (about 5000 pages per year noted in metadata).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors can expect regular publication frequency; the metadata lists first published date (1997) and physical dimensions for the printed journal.
